description: This PHP class parses XML error responses from AWS services, providing details such as error codes, messages, and request IDs from XML response bodies or HTTP headers.

classes.name: XmlErrorParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing XML error responses from AWS API calls, extracting error details such as code, message, and request ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with optional service API details and an XML parser instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser to process an HTTP response and extract error information.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses error information from HTTP headers, particularly handling 404 Not Found errors and extracting request IDs.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the XML body of the response to extract error code, message, and request ID.

methods.name: registerNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Registers the default namespace of the XML document to be used with XPath queries.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the XML Error element within the response body to produce structured error information.
